title: Immaculate Constellation search spike and its deletion from Google Trends

tellings.quote: Uh Immaculate Constellation had like a search spike when David Grush came out in I think August or September of 2023.

plain: Michels says that searches for "Immaculate Constellation", the name of a reported secret government UFO program, spiked online around August or September 2023, when a whistleblower witness named David Grusch came forward, and that this spike was later removed from Google Trends, Google's public record of what people search for. He tells it himself, linking it to the journalist Michael Shellenberger's testimony about the program at a November 2024 congressional hearing and to a man named Rob Jones, as a hint that someone wanted the program's name kept quiet.
